Je helpt mee verzekeren dat installaties voldoen aan geldende wetgeving en interne veiligheidsnormen. Daarbij pas je onder meer methodes toe voor vent sizing, gasdispersiestudies, explosiedrukberekeningen en thermische of kinetische analyses. Je levert daarnaast inhoudelijke input voor projecten, audits en veiligheidsstudies.
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden
Uitvoeren van berekeningen voor drukontlasting , zoals relief valve sizing.
Analyseren van thermische risico’s , runaway reactions en warmtebalansen.
Opstellen van explosie- en brandscenarioanalyses , waaronder gasdispersiestudies, BLEVE, jet fire en pool fire.
Ondersteunen van HAZOP- en LOPA-studies met kwantitatieve berekeningen.
Interpreteren van procesdata en P&ID’s om veiligheidskritische parameters te bepalen.
Verzamelen en toepassen van gegevens uit literatuur, databanken en experimentele testen, bijvoorbeeld chemische reactiedata.
Schrijven van technische rapporten en formuleren van aanbevelingen op basis van berekeningsresultaten.
Samenwerken met procesingenieurs, HSE-experts, projectteams en externe gespecialiseerde partners.
Bijdragen aan evaluaties rond ATEX en impactanalyses in het kader van procesveiligheid.
Gebruikmaken van tools zoals Excel en relevante simulatietoepassingen voor technische calculaties en veiligheidsanalyses.
📝 Jouw profiel
Je behaalde een master in chemische technologie , procestechnologie, veiligheidstechniek of een gelijkwaardige technische richting.
Je hebt minstens 2 tot 3 jaar ervaring in procesveiligheid of in een technische berekeningsrol binnen een industriële omgeving.
Je hebt een grondige kennis van relevante normen en richtlijnen binnen procesveiligheid en HSE.
Je hebt ervaring met tools zoals DWSIM, Aspen Plus, Phast, CFD-software of Excel-gebaseerde calculaties.
Je werkt analytisch, nauwkeurig en met een sterk verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.
Je beschikt over goede technische schrijfvaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels .
Je bent een kritische denker met een gestructureerde aanpak.
Kennis van ATEX en ATEX impact assessments is vereist.

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. As a basic requirement for entry into the SES, applicants must provide evidence of leadership experience indicative of senior executive-level managerial capability and directly related to the experience outlined under the Executive Core Qualifications (ECQs) and the Professional/Technical Qualifications (PTQs).

To meet the minimum qualification requirements for this position, you must show that you possess the ECQs and PTQs related to this position within your resume. RESUME NOT TO EXCEED 2 PAGES. Resumes over the 2-page limit will not be reviewed and will be considered ineligible.

Your resume should be 2 pages or fewer and must not include images, graphics, or hyperlinks (including publications and/or social media). Your resume should include examples of experience, education, and accomplishments applicable to the qualification(s).

If your resume does not reflect demonstrated evidence of these qualifications, you may not receive consideration for the position. PROFESSIONAL TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS (PTQs): Your resume should demonstrate accomplishments that would satisfy the technical qualifications.

PTQ 1 - Demonstrated leadership experience in managing complex programs, including establishing priorities, aligning resources, and building consensus to successfully develop and implement strategies that advance organizational objectives, while communicating effectively, both orally and in writing, and collaborating with stakeholders ranging from technical experts to non-experts.

PTQ 2 - Demonstrated extensive experience in occupational safety and health risk assessment and management, with expertise in fostering and sustaining a strong, integrated safety culture in laboratory or similar environments and ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.

EXECUTIVE CORE QUALIFICATIONS (ECQs): In addition to the PTQ requirements listed above, all new entrants into the Senior Executive Service (SES) under a career appointment will be assessed for executive competency against the following five mandatory ECQs.

If your 2-page resume does not reflect demonstrated evidence of the ECQs and TQs, you may not receive further consideration for the position.

ECQ 1: Commitment to the Rule of Law and the Principles of the American Founding - This core qualification requires a demonstrated knowledge of the American system of government, commitment to uphold the Constitution and the rule of law, and commitment to serve the American people.

ECQ 2: Driving Efficiency - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to strategically and efficiently manage resources, budget effectively, cut wasteful spending, and pursue efficiency through process and technological upgrades.

ECQ 3: Merit and Competence - This core qualification involves the demonstrated knowledge, ability and technical competence to effectively and reliably produce work that is of exceptional quality.

ECQ 4: Leading People - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to lead and inspire a group toward meeting the organization's vision, mission, and goals, and to drive a high-performance, high-accountability culture. This includes, when necessary, the ability to lead people through change and to hold individuals accountable.

ECQ 5: Achieving Results -This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to achieve both individual and organizational results, and to align results to stated goals from superiors.

NOTE: If you are a member of the SES or have been certified through successful participation in an OPM-approved SES Candidate Development Program (SESCDP) or have SES reinstatement eligibility, you do not need to respond to the ECQs.

Instead, you should attach proof (e.g., SF-50, Certification by OPM's SES Qualifications Review Board (QRB)) of your eligibility for noncompetitive appointment to the SES. Applicants must meet all of the qualification requirements by the closing date of this announcement. Applications should be submitted online through usajobs.gov.

The United States Space Force (USSF) at Vandenberg SFB, CA is searching for a System Safety Engineer for SLD 30 (NH-0803-03, GS 12/13 equivalent). Description: Lead the charge in safeguarding mission-critical space launch systems.

We are seeking a dynamic System Safety Engineer to drive safety-critical requirements across Government and Commercial space lift missions, applying rigorous SSCMAN 91-710 and MIL-STD-882E standards.

In this high-impact role, you will lead comprehensive hazard analyses, author safety-derived requirements for hardware and software, actively manage mission risk profiles, and deliver key technical briefings directly to Space Force Leadership and joint industry working groups.

If you thrive on solving complex engineering challenges, championing mission safety from design through launch, and collaborating with top-tier defense and aerospace partners, join our team and secure the future of space operations. Ideal Candidate: Implementation of SSCMAN 91-710 Range Safety Requirements and MIL-STD-882E System Safety principles.

Planning, defining, and verifying system safety requirements and system safety hazard analysis artifacts to ensure design integrity and safety. Verifying the necessary hazard analyses to identify potentially hazardous conditions and recommend actions that would contribute to minimizing or precluding hazards.

Providing validation/verification of requirements and providing feedback to the programs and customers. Analyze technical data with interpretation for application to safety assessments. Identify safety tasks needed during requirements, design, implementation, and verification phases of safety critical item development for both hardware and software.

Author, review and monitor Safety Derived Requirements. Participate in the risk & change management processes for Government and Commercial space lift missions. Document risks and risk mitigation plans and track risk changes over time. Communicate regularly/comprehensively to Space Force Leadership.

Travel, as needed, to support mission requirements. Representing clients with military/industry at system safety working groups and launch vehicle and space craft system working groups. Reviewing client and supplier submitted documents related to system safety engineering SSCMAN 91-710.

Providing guidance to engineering teams and suppliers related to system safety engineering. Working semi-autonomously, with the support of the functional SME, to review and develop Safety artifacts. Support/lead large, complex safety engineering efforts which contribute to overarching customer systems engineering efforts.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS System safety engineering experience in the aerospace or defense industry. Experience with SSCMAN 91-710 Range Safety Requirements and MIL-STD-882E System Safety programs & risk assessment processes.

Experience executing safety analysis techniques such as Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA), Functional Hazard Analysis (FHA), System Hazard Analysis (SHA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Subsystem Hazard Analysis (SSHA), and Failure Modes, Effects, and Criticality Analysis (FMECA), Operating & Support Hazard Analysis and operational procedure evaluation.

Experience generating safety documents such as System Safety Program Plans (SSPP) and Safety Assessment Reports (SAR). Strong communication skills and ability to communicate effectively with varied audiences to gain support or resolve concerns. Excellent attention to detail.

Ability to work on their own initiative and prioritize tasking to fit within the business goals and to quickly adapt to changing priorities. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: Experience with both commercial and military space lift programs.

Familiarity with the Joint Services System Safety Engineering Handbook and the Joint Services - Software Safety Authorities, Software System Safety Implementation guide.

Experience with and technical competency with one of the following: solid and liquid propellants, pressure vessels, COPVs, lightning protection, ordnance, inhibit strategies and launch processing.

Risk Manager / Safety Officer (m/f/d) 80\-100%
Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.

s.h: Safety requires people who take responsibility.
s.t:
At Eawag, people from a variety of disciplines work together to find solutions to one of the key challenges of our time: the protection and sustainable use of water as a resource. To ensure that research, laboratory work, technical installations and day\-to\-day operations run safely and reliably, a professional and forward\-looking safety and risk culture is required. For this challenging and varied role, we are looking for a committed individual to join us as soon as possible as a
Risk Manager / Safety Officer (m/f/d) 80\-100%
In this key role, you will play an active part in shaping and further developing Eawag's safety and risk management, and ensure that risks are identified, assessed and effectively managed at an early stage. In this role, you will combine strategic risk management with operational safety responsibilities and work closely with the Directorate, line managers as well as specialist and safety managers.
Risk management (40\-50%)
You will coordinate and further develop the institutional risk management system and the associated processes, methods and tools, and ensure their implementation.
You will advise the Directorate and risk owners on strategic and methodological issues and prepare the basis for decision\-making for the relevant committees.
You will coordinate the annual risk management process and assist the relevant research and support departments in identifying, assessing and managing risks.
You will be responsible for the maintenance and quality assurance of the risk catalogue, as well as monitoring risk mitigation measures.
You will coordinate and author the annual risk reporting for the Directorate and the ETH Board.
You will be the contact person for risk management audits and reviews, and will coordinate the necessary documentation and position statements.
You will further develop information, training and awareness\-raising measures and represent Eawag on relevant specialist committees within the ETH Domain.
Operational safety (40\-50%)
You will take operational responsibility for safety coordination at the Dübendorf (ZH) and Kastanienbaum (LU) sites and advise the Directorate on safety measures, protection objectives and safety concepts.
You will coordinate the further development and quality assurance of safety guidelines and requirements\-based training for laboratory, field and experimental work.
As part of your responsibilities, you will be responsible for general occupational health and safety, risk assessments, planning measures and monitoring safety\-related requirements.
You will implement safety\-related measures within your area of responsibility and consult external experts where necessary.
You will coordinate and monitor emergency planning and drills, support the internal crisis management team in the event of an incident, and ensure deputy leadership for the crisis management team.
You will be part of the occupational health management team or the relevant steering committee and will coordinate the links between occupational health and safety, and occupational health management.
You will coordinate and accompany audits, inspections and regulatory site visits, and maintain close cooperation with regulatory bodies, specialist departments and external safety partners.
You will represent Eawag on safety committees and working groups within the ETH Domain.
Your profile
Several years' professional experience in risk, safety or quality management, ideally in a complex research, academic or technical environment.
A university degree or equivalent qualification, ideally in a field related to risk management, safety, natural sciences, engineering or a related discipline.
In\-depth knowledge of risk management, ideally in accordance with ISO 31000, as well as a good understanding of health and safety issues.
Training as an ASGS specialist or ASGS expert
Extensive experience in advising senior managers and coordinating cross\-functional processes, projects and teams.
A structured, independent and solution\-oriented approach to work, as well as the ability to communicate complex issues clearly.
Clear communication in German, another national language and English, as well as a confident and courteous manner when dealing with a range of different contacts.
At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.
Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it \- we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information please visit our website about Eawag as well as our conditions of employment.
The closing date for applications is 15 October 2026\. If necessary, the vacancy will remain open until the post is filled. Please submit the following documents with your application: CV, letter of motivation, relevant employment references, and relevant diplomas and qualifications.
If you require any further information, please do not hesitate to email , Deputy Director.
We look forward to receiving your application. Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the button below will take you directly to the application form.

* Approche pragmatique, structurée et orientée terrain.

* Fonction à forte dimension opérationnelle et transverse.
* Rôle central dans le déploiement de la stratégie HSE de l'entreprise.
* Interactions régulières avec les différentes équipes de l'organisation.
* Environnement favorisant l'amélioration continue des processus et des standards HSE.

Participer aux réunions et comités de santé et sécurité.

Identifier les dangers, analyser les situations à risque et recommander les mesures de contrôle appropriées.
Assurer le suivi des incidents, accidents, observations et situations problématiques.
Documenter les écarts et assurer le suivi des mesures correctives et préventives.
Collaborer avec les entrepreneurs, sous-traitants, professionnels et autres intervenants du projet.
Développer et maintenir des outils de suivi, registres et indicateurs de performance SST.
Produire des rapports périodiques et contribuer à la reddition de comptes auprès de l’équipe de gestion de projet.
Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la performance SST du chantier.

Formation pertinente en santé et sécurité au travail, prévention, construction, génie ou discipline connexe.

Connaissance des lois, règlements et pratiques applicables en matière de santé et sécurité au travail au Québec.

Expérience sur des projets majeurs ou complexes de construction.
Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques courants.
Excellente maîtrise du français parlé et écrit.
Capacité à rédiger des rapports professionnels, structurés et précis.

Leadership en matière de prévention et capacité d’influence positive.
Jugement, autonomie et capacité d’analyse.
Sens de l’observation et rigueur documentaire.
Capacité à intervenir de façon professionnelle dans des situations sensibles.
Excellente communication avec différents niveaux d’intervenants.
Sens de l’organisation, gestion des priorités et approche collaborative orientée solutions.

Thoughtworks is looking for a Health & Safety Specialist to join our team in Romania to work both locally and globally to ensure Thoughtworkers are healthy and safe.

Keep up to date with changes in HSE legislation and best practices to ensure company compliance.

Technical Skills
Design and deliver health & safety training programs for employees at all levels, including emergency response, first aid, ergonomics, and safe work practices.
Promote a strong safety culture within the company by driving awareness campaigns and safety committees.
Lead and manage safety drills and emergency preparedness exercises.
Incident Management & Reporting.
Investigate workplace accidents, incidents, and near-misses, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.
Maintain and analyze incident reports and trends to drive continuous safety improvements. Ensure the proper reporting of occupational illnesses and accidents to regulatory authorities.
Act as the main point of contact for all health & safety-related matters within the organization.

Professional Skills
A mandatory Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in one of the fundamental fields: Engineering Sciences or Agricultural and Forestry Sciences.
Compliance with the higher-level training requirements, met by either.

Strong knowledge of Romanian SSM legislation Law 319/2006 (Health & Safety at Work) and national norms.
Certifications in Health and Safety (e.g. NEBOSH, IOSH, ISO 45001 Lead Auditor) are highly desirable.
